abstract: Early and reliable detection of pancreatic cancer (PC) remains a formidable clinical challenge, largely owing to the limited sensitivity, operational unreliability, and enzyme dependence of existing carbohydrate antigen 19-9 (CA19-9) immunoassays. In this work, we determine for the first time that ZnO-Pd nanobolts show intrinsic oxidase-like activity. Furthermore, this attribute was used to fabricate a colorimetric immunoanalytical sensor based on nanozymes for the sensitive and specific detection of CA19-9, a biomarker for PC. In this research, immunoreagent optimization, smartphone-assisted signal analysis, and kinetic analysis of nanozyme catalytic activity were employed to enable highly sensitive detection of CA19-9. Enzyme-kinetic studies showed low Michaelis-Menten constants (KM) of 0.99 mM, as well as high turnover numbers (kcat) and catalytic efficiencies (kcat/KM) of 4.48 × 10-4 s-1 and 0.453 M-1 s-1, respectively, indicating high substrate affinity. The optimized nanozyme was functionalized with Goat anti-mouse IgG (GAM IgG), thereby facilitating antigen recognition and signal transduction. The proposed immunoassay demonstrated high analytical sensitivity (LOD of 0.000159 U mL-1 and LOQ of 0.000482 U mL-1) and exceptional selectivity even in complex biological matrices. Software-assisted signal processing enabled precise assessment of the limit of detection (LOD) of 0.000359 U mL-1 and the limit of quantification (LOQ) of 0.00108 U mL-1. The practical utility of the fabricated immunoassay was further examined using human serum, with recovery rates ranging from 100.6% to 102%, indicating high accuracy and reproducibility. Furthermore, the successful digitalization of assay results into software-based readable data demonstrates the sensing approach's potential for portable, cost-effective, and point-of-care PC diagnostics.
key_points_ko: 새로 개발된 센서의 검출 한계(LOD)는 0.000159 U/mL, 정량 한계(LOQ)는 0.000482 U/mL로 매우 높은 민감도를 기록했습니다.
소프트웨어를 통한 신호 처리 시에도 검출 한계 0.000359 U/mL, 정량 한계 0.00108 U/mL의 정밀한 측정이 가능했습니다.
인체 혈청 검사에서 100.6%~102%의 회수율을 보여 복잡한 생체 시료 내에서도 우수한 정확도를 확인했습니다.
summary_ko: 췌장암 바이오마커인 CA19-9를 조기에 정밀하게 검출하기 위해 산화아연-팔라듐(ZnO-Pd) 나노볼트 나노자임을 활용한 새로운 면역 센서가 개발되었습니다. 연구진은 효소 유사 활성을 지닌 나노볼트에 항체를 결합하고 스마트폰 소프트웨어 신호 분석을 결합하여 극미량의 CA19-9도 감지할 수 있도록 설계했습니다. 이 면역분석법은 인체 혈청 샘플에서도 100.6%~102%의 높은 회수율을 보이며 뛰어난 정확성과 재현성을 입증했습니다. 이는 향후 휴대 가능하고 경제적인 췌장암 현장 현장진단(POC) 기기로의 활용 가능성을 보여줍니다.
title: ZnO-Pd nanobolts-based immunoanalytical detection of a pancreatic cancer biomarker and its software-assisted digital quantification
title_ko: 산화아연-팔라듐 나노볼트 기반 췌장암 바이오마커 면역분석 검출 및 소프트웨어 기반 디지털 정량화
